One minor visual defect found: --- ## Folio Independent Review — Commit e8ad41b ### Scoped items confirmed **Four-destination navigation + Assessment active state** (`main.tsx:813–844`): Nav renders exactly four items (Overview, Records, Report, Settings). When `page === "Assessment"`, the Overview button receives both `className="active"` and `aria-current="page"` via the `p === "Overview" && page === "Assessment"` guard. ✓ **Keyboard heading focus** (`main.tsx:565–570`, `main.tsx:854`): On page change, `window.scrollTo({ top:0, behavior:"instant" })` fires first, then `titleRef.current?.focus({ preventScroll:true })` moves focus to the `

`. The `previousPage` ref prevents re-focusing on the initial mount (only fires when the page actually changes). The browser test at `flow.spec.ts:39–41` asserts `toHaveAttribute("aria-current","page")` and `toBeFocused()` for the h1. ✓ **Reduced-motion** (`style.css:2217–2227`): The `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` block nulls all transitions and animations with `!important` and resets `scroll-behavior` to `auto`. `surface-enter` (translateY only, no opacity fade) and `pending-pulse` are both suppressed. ✓ **Mobile bottom nav** (`style.css:1780–1825`): At `≤800px` the shell switches from `display:grid` to `display:block` and `.app-nav` becomes `position:fixed; bottom:0; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr))`. Safe-area inset is handled (`calc(8px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom))`). Workspace bottom padding is `90px` at mobile, clearing the 68px+ nav bar. ✓ **Pending/error states**: `role="alert"` is applied to error divs at `main.tsx:621,786`. The cashflow `CashflowSection` error falls back to a `

` without `role="alert"` (`main.tsx:159`), but that's a degraded-data warning rather than an action-blocking error. ✓ **Caveats preserved**: Assessment heading, score small-print, `nav-note` ("Experimental scorecard v1"), and all `.caution` partial-evidence wording from prior reviews remain in place. ✓ --- ### BUG-1 — P3 · Settings icon circle fill breaks slider metaphor on mobile active state `src/components/Icon.tsx:35–36` ```tsx settings: ( <> // ← hardcoded white ) ``` The slider-handle effect relies on the circle fill matching the surface behind the icon. On desktop the `.app-nav` background is `var(--white)`, so the circles correctly occlude the horizontal line. On mobile, the active nav icon receives `background: var(--pale); outline: 6px solid var(--pale)` (`style.css:1817–1820`). The `fill="var(--white)"` circles no longer match the `var(--pale)` container, so the horizontal lines show through both circles — breaking the slider metaphor into what looks like a line crossing a circle. **Reproduction**: Select the Settings nav item on a viewport ≤800px. The Settings icon's active-indicator background is `var(--pale)`; the icon circles remain white, visually disconnected from the surface. **Impact**: Cosmetic only. The icon is still recognizable as a controls glyph, and no functional regression occurs. **Suggested fix**: Either replace the masking fill with a CSS variable that matches the current surface, or use an alternative settings icon that doesn't rely on background-matching (e.g., a gear/cog path with strokes only): ```tsx // Option A: inherit from a CSS custom property set on the button // Then in CSS: .app-nav button.active .icon { --icon-bg: var(--pale); } // Option B: switch to a stroke-only sliders icon that needs no fill masking ``` --- No other actionable defects found in the scoped UI checkpoint.
